findings.title: Task 2 cannot reach its required passing checkpoint
findings.description: Task 2 expands `SnapshotMetric` while restricting `PythonAdapter.metrics` to four metrics, then requires the suite to pass unchanged. However, `tests/metrology/snapshot/test_python_length.py:60` asserts that the adapter declares every enum member. Update that assertion alongside the transitional declaration, preserving length-value expectations. Otherwise the first implementation checkpoint necessarily fails.

findings.title: Python complexity fixture contradicts the counting definition
findings.description: The required fixture scores **7**, not 6: baseline 1, `if`, `elif`, `and`, comprehension `for`, comprehension `if`, and `except`. This contradiction originates in slice criterion 3 and is repeated here. Reconcile the fixture and expected score with D2 before implementation.

findings.title: Duplication scalability requirement lacks load testing and CI gating
findings.description: D3 explicitly requires linear time and memory growth. Task 11 tests small examples and a lowered token ceiling, neither of which validates scalability. Add a proportional load test under `tests/load/` covering increasing token volumes, followed immediately by an explicit CI-wiring task that gates on it.

findings.title: Commit checkpoints use checkbox items instead of markers
findings.description: Commit instructions throughout the file use `- [ ] Commit:`. Replace these with plain `**Commit**:` lines at tested checkpoints. Most implementation/test pairs already provide sensible checkpoint locations; additional commits after every task are unnecessary.
